meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过个人微信账号收发消息。使用腾讯官方 iLink API，通过扫码登录和长轮询接收消息，无需 webhook 或付费 token。
howto.when: 在你启用微信、扫码登录并完成接线后，有人发微信消息给机器人时触发。

say.note: 会启用 WECHAT_ENABLED 并提示扫码登录。
运行 wire-dm.ts 完成接线，之后可自动回复。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can send/receive messages via your personal WeChat account. Uses Tencent's official iLink API with QR-code login and long-polling — no webhook or paid token.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you enable WECHAT_ENABLED=true, restart the service, scan the QR code, and wire the channel — then any incoming WeChat message to the bot triggers a response.

say_en.note: Enables WECHAT_ENABLED and prompts for QR scan.

say_en.text: Scan QR code to log in WeChat
say_en.note: Prints QR URL and saves to data/wechat/qr.txt.

say_en.text: Connect WeChat to an agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to wire messaging group.
